roles.title: Staff Product Manager, AI Software Factory PLG

bullets: Define and maintain a 12–18-month product strategy for a cross-team part of GitLab’s AI Software Factory, with customer adoption and growth as core outcomes.
Own the adoption journey from discovery and onboarding through activation, time-to-first-value, repeat usage, team adoption, retention, and conversion or expansion.
Identify friction in the end-user, administrator, and buyer journeys, and prioritize improvements that help customers realize value and broaden adoption.
Set outcome measures for product and growth initiatives; use product usage data, customer feedback, and experiments to evaluate impact and adjust direction.
Build a steady test-and-learn approach, including clear hypotheses, experiment design, and sharing results and learnings across partner teams.

roles.title: Senior Product Manager, CRM & GTM Systems

bullets: Define, own, and maintain the multi-quarter internal product roadmap for the Lead-to-Opportunity domain covering lead capture, enrichment, scoring, routing, conversion…
Translate business strategy from Marketing, Sales Development, RevOps, and GTM leadership into sequenced, prioritized system capabilities with clear outcomes and success metrics
Define the domain’s strategic priorities each quarter and half, balancing net-new capability delivery, stabilization, and technical debt reduction with transparent trade-off…
Drive quarterly planning ceremonies, partnering with Engineering Managers and BSAs to align capacity with roadmap commitments
Own domain-level documentation: process maps, current-vs-future state lead lifecycle flows, and decision logs that keep stakeholders and the team aligned on scope and ownership

roles.title: Senior Product Manager, Billing Engine & Platforms Monetization
roles.location: Remote, United Kingdom; Remote, United States

bullets: Own the product direction for metering, aggregation, and rating in GitLab’s usage billing pipeline, including the Zuora and CustomersDot integrations that turn usage into invoiced…
Make onboarding a new credit-consuming capability a repeatable process rather than a bespoke project each time.
Partner with product teams on what to instrument, how to meter and price usage across GitLab.com, self-managed, and GitLab Dedicated, and what it takes to be billable on launch…
Prioritize pipeline scalability, performance, and reliability as consumption grows, balancing those investments against new capability enablement.
Own billing defect detection and remediation so errors surface before they reach a customer’s invoice and billing outcomes remain auditable.

roles.title: Staff Product Manager,  RevOps & Finance Systems

bullets: Define, own, and maintain the multi-quarter internal product roadmap for QTC and Finance Systems, covering Salesforce CPQ, Zuora Billing, Zuora Revenue, NetSuite, and the CDot…
Translate business strategy from Finance, Revenue Operations, Deal Desk, and Sales into sequenced, prioritized system capabilities with clear outcomes and success metrics.
Balance competing program demands—stabilization, net-new capability delivery, and technical debt reduction—with transparent trade-off frameworks.
Drive quarterly and annual planning ceremonies, partnering with Engineering Managers and Business Systems Analysts to align capacity with roadmap commitments.

roles.title: Senior Product Manager, Agentic Source Code

bullets: Define and drive product strategy for experiences that connect planning, source code management, and AI-assisted development.
Shape workflows where teams and agents move between intent and code in both directions, so a specification can be traced to the merges that implement it and a diff can be read and…
Work with engineering, design, and other product teams to build product experiences that support human-in-the-loop and autonomous development workflows.
Partner with teams working on demos and prototypes, including near-term work around spec-driven planning and autonomous development modes, including which decisions stay with a…
Use customer insights, product usage data, and market context to identify opportunities that can deliver customer value quickly.

roles.title: Director of Product Management, Agentic Software Delivery

bullets: Own the strategy, three-year vision, and business outcomes for GitLab’s Agentic Software Delivery section, with a clear point of view on how artificial intelligence is changing…
Lead and develop senior and principal product managers across Continuous Integration, Artifact Management, Continuous Deployment, and Observability, helping them grow as…
Establish the frameworks, standards, and operating rhythm that support consistent, high-quality product decisions without unnecessary escalation.
Own section-level key performance indicators and adoption funnels, using the results to reallocate investment or stop work that isn’t paying off.
Evaluate major strategic bets, partnerships, and build, buy, or partner decisions, and develop the business cases that support them.

roles.title: Principal Product Manager, AI Software Factory

bullets: Define the product vision and strategy for GitLab’s end-to-end software factory experience.
Bring together planning, specification, coding, review, and verification workflows into a cohesive product experience.
Partner with product, engineering, design, and go-to-market teams across GitLab to align priorities and execution.
Identify gaps, dependencies, and opportunities across GitLab Duo Agent Platform and related areas of the GitLab product.
Use strong product and design judgment to make complex workflows clear and useful for customers.
